newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Chem, Dow Chem to set up venture in China.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Chem, Dow Chem to set up venture in China.

text.p: Asahi Chemical Industry Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it and Dow Chemical Co of the United States plan to set up a joint venture in China to produce polystyrene.
The companies plan to spend about 10 billion yen to build a factory with an annual production capacity of 120,000 tonnes of polystyrene near Shanghai, an Asahi Chemical spokesman said.
Production is expected to start in 1999, he said.
Polystyrene is mainly used in the production of parts for electrical appliances.
"We can expect demand for this material to increase as Japanese electrical appliance makers are expanding production in China," said the spokesman.
The spokesman declined to provide more details of the joint venture, including its starting capital and the shareholding ratio.
